title: Patience in saintly company
subtitle: A short return when waiting has become agitation
description: A brief path that places impatience near sangat, mercy, and listening until waiting becomes less lonely and more luminous.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The mind’s wanderings cease in the Society of the Saints, where mercy begins to enlighten the mind.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Do not wait alone inside your own weather; stand near the company that teaches steadiness.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle gives impatience a better place to dwell.
evidence.turn: Patience ripens where the mind stops roaming by itself.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before forcing the timeline, return to one practice or person that helps you listen.
